source: A dynamic ZXNAME0000XZ naturally gives different experts different token counts. Dense accelerator kernels prefer regular, sufficiently large matrices. That mismatch historically pushed runtimes toward fixed capacities, padding, or token dropping.
zh: 动态的 ZXNAME0000XZ 自然会为不同的专家提供不同的代币计数。密集加速器内核更喜欢规则的、足够大的矩阵。历史上，这种不匹配将运行时推向固定容量、填充或令牌丢弃。
